title: REJOICING IN HOPE
PATIENCE IN PRAYER
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: sunlight streaming through clean window onto wooden desk
soft dust motes dancing in midday light
top down view of empty open journal on desk
still mountain lake with midday sun reflection
blurred sunlight on neutral colored linen curtain
close up of indoor plant leaves in midday light

scenes.a: That heavy weight of expectation you are carrying into this afternoon needs to be surrendered now.
Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
Lord, let these words settle into the center of my spirit during this frantic, busy hour.
When the world demands my attention, help me to remain anchored in your perfect, quiet love.
Give me the endurance to stay steadfast while I wait for your timing to unfold perfectly.
May this midday pause redefine my perspective so I see your grace in every small detail.
